description:
Add a little structure to your daily chaos.

You know the feeling: twelve things in your head, all of them urgent, and no idea where to start. ThinkSort gives you one place to dump it all out and one clear answer to the only question that matters - what do I do right now?

BRAIN DUMP, NOT DATA ENTRY
Speak or type one long, messy ramble. ThinkSort sorts it into dated tasks, prep items, shopping and ideas, and shows you a confirm screen before anything is saved. Nothing gets stored until you say so.

IT NEVER GUESSES
The organizer is rule-based and runs entirely on your device. It will not invent dates, times or places. If something is ambiguous, it becomes a short clarification you answer yourself - so your list stays true to what you actually said.

ONE NEXT THING
The Today screen shows a single NEXT UP card with a plain-language reason why it is next. Start it, mark it done, push it to later, or tap I am Stuck. One Thing Mode hides everything else when even a short list feels like too much.

WHEN YOU FREEZE
I am Stuck asks what is making the task hard - from seven common reasons - and hands back one tiny first step. Where I Left Off recaps what you were doing before you got pulled away, so you do not have to rebuild the context from scratch.

FOCUS AND FOLLOW-THROUGH
A built-in focus timer with 5, 15, 25 or custom durations keeps you on one task at a time. Shopping lists group by store with one-tap check-off. Upcoming, Notes and Search are there when you want the bigger picture.

HANDS-FREE CAPTURE
Siri and Shortcuts support means you can capture a thought or ask what is next without unlocking anything. Catch the idea before it disappears.

COMPLETELY PRIVATE
No account. No cloud. No analytics. No ads. Everything you write stays in local storage on your device, and every permission is optional. Your brain dump is nobody else business.

TRY IT FREE, THEN BUY IT ONCE
ThinkSort is free for your first 7 days - the whole app, nothing locked off. After that, one purchase unlocks it for good. No subscription, no monthly fee, and no upgrade nagging you in the corner.

Built for people who juggle too many open loops - adults with ADHD or executive-function struggles, and anyone who is simply chronically overwhelmed. ThinkSort is an organization tool, not a health product: it does not assess or treat anything. It just holds your list and points at the next step.

Dump your head out. Get one thing to do. Download ThinkSort and start there.
promotionalText: Dump everything on your mind in one ramble. ThinkSort sorts it and shows you one next step. Offline, no account. Free for 7 days, then one purchase - yours for good.
whatsNew:
ThinkSort now starts with a free 7-day trial - the whole app, no card and no account needed.

After the trial you unlock ThinkSort with a single one-time purchase. No subscription, and no renewals ever.

Your tasks and notes always stay on your device, whether you unlock or not.

Also in this update: clearer trial status in Settings, and Restore Purchase if you already own ThinkSort on another iPhone.
